entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: You took care of that teacher,[n]right? The one that was picking on[n]her junior?

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: It seems like she's less of a bully[n]now. She's starting to act like[n]a proper mentor.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: I'm just glad it didn't escalate to[n]the level that Kamoshida took it.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: When things are bad between the[n]teachers, it's always the students[n]who get caught in the crossfire.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Kinda makes you wonder what[n]would've happened to Shujin[n]without the Phantom Thieves.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Yeah. I know I would've had it[n]rough, at least. The Phantom[n]Thieves saved me.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: You think so? Well, no matter[n]what the public thinks, I'll[n]always support them!

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Don't say that! I'll always support[n]them, no matter what people say!

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: For now, at least, we've brought[n]some peace back to the school.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Let's keep up the good work!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Looks like that's a case closed!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: This was a pretty small-time target,[n]but it was still good for our rep.
